newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Radiometer see lower 96/97 gains.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Radiometer see lower 96/97 gains.

text.p: Danish medical equipment group Radiometer A/S on Thursday adjusted its expectations downward for full year 1996/97 net profit to 180 million crowns on turnover of around 1.770 billion crowns.

Last June, when the company unveiled 1995/96 full year net profits of 231.2 million crowns on 1.682 billion crown turnover, it forecast a 1996/97 net profit of around 200 million crowns on 1.775 billion crown turnover.
Radiometer said in a statement that its lower expectations were based on 1996/97 results so far.
It said it had decided to stop acquisition plans and concentrate on developing its medical division and consolidating its strong position in the in vitro diagnostics market.

It said it had signed up Goldman Sachs International and Aros investment banks to look for a suitable partner with whom it could work on maintaining and expanding its market position. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
